adql: SELECT source_id, ra, ra_error, dec, dec_error, parallax, parallax_error, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, radial_velocity, radial_velocity_error, ref_epoch, ra_dec_corr, ra_parallax_corr, ra_pmra_corr, ra_pmdec_corr, dec_parallax_corr, dec_pmra_corr, dec_pmdec_corr, parallax_pmra_corr, parallax_pmdec_corr, pmra_pmdec_corr, duplicated_source, phot_g_mean_mag, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax IS NOT NULL AND parallax > 20.000000 AND parallax_error > 0 AND parallax / parallax_error >= 10.000000 ORDER BY parallax DESC
